changes: Validate both VP9 header spans and required payload; reject failed/incomplete submissions.
Retain colour range on inter frames; only commit persistent range/filter/segmentation state after successful submission.
Reject missing, detached or cross-context active reference buffers before submission.
limitations: Asynchronous hardware failure after accepted submission is outside persistent-state rollback.
Sub-64 dimensions, inter-frame resizing and scalable-video failures remain open.
Decoded-pixel tests do not validate browser/display colour management.

from pathlib import Path
import json
import os, subprocess, sys, time
from avdlab.guard import preflight, run, ResultLog, wedge_monitor, decoder_state
out=Path("results/codec-r10-package"); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
log=ResultLog(out/"guard.jsonl")
repo="/home/chrisk/src/publish/libva-v4l2_request"
driver="/home/chrisk/src/avd-lab/results/builds/codec-r10-package/pkg/libva-v4l2_request-avd/usr/lib/dri"
passed=[x['vector'] for x in map(json.loads,Path("results/codec-r10-baseline/vp9/results.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()) if x['event']=='result' and x['success']]
since=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
def monitor():
    clients = [h for h in decoder_state().holders if any(client in h["cmd"] for client in ("chrome", "firefox", "mpv"))]
    if clients:
        return "unrelated video client: " + str(clients)
    reason = wedge_monitor()
    if reason:
        return reason
    journal = subprocess.run(["journalctl", "-k", "--since", since, "--no-pager", "-o", "cat"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    if journal.returncode:
        return "kernel journal read failed"
    failures = [line for line in journal.stdout.splitlines() if "avd" in line.lower() and any(word in line.lower() for word in ("error", "timeout", "failed"))]
    return "new decoder error: " + failures[0] if failures else None

try:
    for name,suite,extra in [("high10","VP9-TEST-VECTORS-HIGH",["--vectors","vp92-2-20-10bit-yuv420.webm"]),("vp9","VP9-TEST-VECTORS",[])]:
        st=preflight()
        cmd=["python3",repo+"/tests/conformance.py","/home/chrisk/src/fluster/test_suites/vp9/"+suite+".json","/home/chrisk/src/fluster/resources","--driver",driver,"--output",str(out/name),*extra]
        log.write(event="start",name=name,state=st,cmd=cmd)
        r=run(cmd,deadline=300,log_dir=out,name=name,abort_if=monitor, poll=0.5)
        log.write(event="result",name=name,result=r,state=decoder_state())
        print(name,r.returncode,r.stdout.splitlines()[-2:],flush=True)
        if r.timed_out or r.wedged or r.abort_reason or r.returncode not in ((0,1) if name == "vp9" else (0,)) or monitor(): sys.exit(2)
    preflight()
    cmd=["sh",repo+"/tests/vp9-matrix.sh",driver]
    log.write(event="start",name="matrix",cmd=cmd)
    r=run(cmd,deadline=240,log_dir=out,name="matrix",abort_if=monitor, poll=0.5)
    log.write(event="result",name="matrix",result=r,state=decoder_state())
    print("matrix",r.returncode,r.stdout,flush=True)
    if r.timed_out or r.wedged or r.abort_reason or r.returncode or monitor(): sys.exit(2)
finally:
    (out/"kernel.log").write_text(subprocess.run(["journalctl","-k","--since",since,"--no-pager","-o","short-precise"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30).stdout)
